public_profile.summary: Cervin Ventures 是一家专注企业软件的早期风险投资机构。官网称其通过产品与市场策略、领域专家网络、客户引荐及投后服务支持创业公司，并公开展示企业应用、基础设施、数据与安全等组合公司。

facts.label: 投资阶段
facts.value: 早期企业软件公司；官网称其关注具有独特市场洞察、以资本效率推进业务的团队。

facts.label: 创业支持：策略咨询
facts.value: 官网称团队与创始人并肩工作，为产品和市场策略提供指导。

facts.label: 创业支持：组合服务
facts.value: 2023 年公告称其组合服务团队提供 go-to-market 策略、业务拓展与市场研究支持。

facts.label: 团队履历
value: Neeraj Gupta — 联合创始人、合伙人；此前创立并管理 Nexient，亦创立 Cymbal（后被 Patni/Cap Gemini 收购）。
Shirish Sathaye — 合伙人；官网列出的投资方向包括企业软件、云软件、AI 企业、数据基础设施与网络系统。
Taylor Oliver — 合伙人；关注 B2B 商务、金融科技与供应链，加入 Cervin 前参与创设两支早期基金。
Scott Brown — 合伙人、平台负责人；官网称其有超过 25 年 B2B 营销经历，曾在 Google、Facebook、Cisco 等高增长企业任职。

facts.label: 历史基金披露
facts.value: 2023 年官网宣布募集 1.62 亿美元新资本并推出组合服务团队；同一公告称管理资产超过 3.35 亿美元。该数字为 2023 年时点的机构披露。

milestones.description: 官网宣布募集 1.62 亿美元新资本，并成立由 Scott Brown 负责的 portfolio services 团队。

track_record.description: Lemma · Pre-seed · 2026-08-07 · 融资来源列出 Cervin Ventures 为参投机构；公开总额 230 万美元，不代表 Cervin 的单笔投资额。
官网展示的代表性组合公司包括 AiFi、ArmorCode、Celona、Paystand、Remi 与 Stream Security；属于官网选列案例，不是完整组合清单。

public_profile.experience_summary: Cervin 的团队成员具有创办企业、企业软件经营、B2B 营销和基金管理经历；上述经历来自机构自述，未据此推断未公开的个人投资业绩。

sources.quote: We work side by side with our founders and provide guidance on product and market strategy.

Neeraj Gupta is a Co-Founder and Partner at Cervin. Previously, Neeraj was the founder and CEO of Nexient, a digital experience consulting firm, and Cymbal, a telecommunications consultancy (acquired by Patni/Cap Gemini). He also held engineering and product management positions at Octel and Genesys. … For 20+ years, Shirish has served as a General Partner across several venture firms. Prior to joining Cervin, he spent 10 years at Matrix Partners, 3 years at Khosla Ventures, and the remainder at Formation 8. … Before joining Cervin, Taylor played an integral role in launching two separate first time funds, the Plug & Play Supply Chain Fund and Tenacity Venture Capital. … Scott Brown is a partner at Cervin leading the firm’s portfolio services team delivering pre and post-investment support to both portfolio companies and the investing team. Scott has more than 25 years of B2B marketing experience in both start-ups and hypergrowth companies like Google, Facebook and Cisco.

sources.source_title: Investing in the future of enterprise software, entrepreneurs | Cervin
sources.quote: This morning Cervin Ventures announced the close of $162 million of new capital for us to invest in enterprise startups. In addition, we’re excited to announce the launch of our portfolio services team, led by Silicon Valley veteran Scott Brown, to help our entrepreneurs accelerate the growth of their businesses. … Grown our Assets Under Management (AUM) to more than $335 million. … We remain dedicated to helping founders of early-stage, enterprise software companies in their quest to build enduring companies. We are looking for entrepreneurs with unique insights on how to disrupt markets and the grit to execute on their vision in a capital efficient manner.
